comments.why: Explains how Cuba's weekly packet distributes media offline via flown-in drives
comments.text: I'd recommend watching the video that is linked: [VIDEO] It talks about the mechanics, largely it looks like someone in Miami is consistently collecting stuff until they get close to 1TB or a week has passed, then that 1TB is flown out to Havana and it's copied and passed around after that.
